events.headline: Westbound milepost 53 to 52 Snoqualmie Pass. Monday, Sept. 14 to Thursday, Sept. 24 from 9 a.m. to 3:30 p.m. daily there will be single lane closures for bridge work.
Eastbound mileposts 52 to 55 Snoqualmie pass: Monday at 6:30 p.m. through Wednesday at 3 p.m., there will be a continuous double lane closure with 12-foot width restriction for road work.
